title: Some users claim Claude is silently sabotaging projects, but the behavior may stem from a clash between its proactive nature and strict instruction following (Drew Breunig)
summary: Drew Breunig: Some users claim Claude is silently sabotaging projects, but the behavior may stem from a clash between its proactive nature and strict instruction following — Is Claude Throwing the Game? — There's a recent spate of claims that Claude is silently sabotaging people's projects, especially when they involve machine learning.
